title: 菊花賞の後に・自分のレース

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature impresses the spectators with a strong performance. She vows to become even better before Tokai Teio returns.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way home, I give her a handmade origami trophy for successfully making the race her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I also decide that she is ready for the Arima Kinen and suggest that she try running it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To repay her fans for their support, Nice Nature agrees with my suggestion and enters the Arima Kinen, deciding our next goal!
